name: Machvision Inc.
summary: Machvision Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing, repair, and sale of optical inspection machinery and equipment in Taiwan, China, and internationally. The company offers machine vision systems, integrating optical imaging, image processing, precision mechanics, and motion control, as well as solutions for non-contact precision measurement, automated optical inspection, automated visual inspection, and laser via inspection. It also provides wafer inspection; IC packaging testing; four-wire electrical tests; and circuit board testing, including hardboard, flexible board, and IC substrate.
